title: IN ADDITION TO THE MORNING SACRIFICE

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "He also brought the grain offering, took a handful of it and burned it on the altar in addition to the morning's burnt offering." - Lev 9:17 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
In addition to the morning's burnt offering.

This is a small detail with a large implication. Even on this extraordinary day — the inauguration of the priesthood, the day God's glory would appear — the ordinary daily sacrifice still happened.

The special did not replace the regular.

We are often tempted to think the reverse. A conference weekend, a mission trip, an unusually powerful season of prayer — and we quietly assume these substitute for daily faithfulness. They do not. The morning sacrifice went on being offered every morning, whatever else was happening.

Spiritual life is built far more on the unremarkable than on the memorable. Daily reading, daily prayer, daily choosing kindness when nobody is watching. Jesus spoke of taking up a cross daily (Lk 9:23). The Bereans examined the Scriptures every day (Acts 17:11).

Great days come and go. The morning offering is what actually forms a life.

Do not let the extraordinary crowd out the ordinary.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do I substitute occasional spiritual highs for daily faithfulness?
2. What small daily practice would strengthen me most if I recovered it?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You for the memorable moments with You. Keep me faithful in the ordinary daily ones that shape me most. Amen.
